# DAYIN Sport

> DAYIN Sport (Dongguan Dayin Plastic Factory Ltd, JINWEI Group) is an ODM and OEM manufacturer of electronic dartboards, Bluetooth dartboards, cabinet dartboards, soft-tip boards and accessories, founded in 2004 in Chang'an, Dongguan, China, with a second plant in Bắc Ninh, Vietnam (2024). Public contact: sport@madeindayin.com.

Company figures marked "being confirmed" on the site come from the 2026 catalogue and are being verified; the fact sheet lists sources.

## Company
- [Facts & figures](https://dayinsport.com/about/facts/): every company figure with its source and status
- [About](https://dayinsport.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://dayinsport.com/contact/)

## OEM & ODM
- [Electronic Dartboard OEM & ODM Manufacturer](https://dayinsport.com/oem-odm/): OEM and ODM for electronic dartboards: your brand on a proven model, or a new product developed with DAYIN. Moulds, injection and assembly in-house; quote in 72 hours.
- [Private Label Dartboards: Configure Your OEM Board](https://dayinsport.com/oem-odm/private-label/): Private label electronic dartboards: choose segment, colours, door panel and display, then send the spec for a quote. Built in Dongguan or Bắc Ninh by DAYIN.
- [Custom Electronic Dartboard Development (ODM)](https://dayinsport.com/oem-odm/custom-development/): ODM development of electronic dartboards: product definition, hardware, firmware and app in-house, own moulds and assembly. 100+ patents, 50+ R&D staff (to confirm).
- [OEM Process, Samples & Lead Times](https://dayinsport.com/oem-odm/process/): How an electronic dartboard OEM project runs at DAYIN: quotation in 72 hours, samples in 7–14 days, mass production in 25–60 days, 12-month warranty.

## Factories & quality
- [Electronic Dartboard Factory: Moulds to Assembly](https://dayinsport.com/factory/): DAYIN makes electronic dartboards in its own plants: mould making, injection moulding, secondary processing and electronic assembly in Dongguan, China and Bắc Ninh, Vietnam.
- [Electronic Dartboard Factory in Dongguan, China](https://dayinsport.com/factory/dongguan-china/): DAYIN was founded in 2004 in Chang’an, Dongguan, as part of the JINWEI Group. Tooling and precision injection moulding are in Chang’an; electronic dartboard a
- [Dartboard Manufacturer in Vietnam: Bắc Ninh Plant](https://dayinsport.com/factory/bac-ninh-vietnam/): In 2024 DAYIN opened a plant in Bắc Ninh, Vietnam (Nam Sơn – Hạp Lĩnh industrial zone), giving clients who need a non-China origin a second manufacturing base
- [Quality Control for Electronic Dartboards](https://dayinsport.com/quality/): How DAYIN controls dartboard quality: high-precision hit sensors, impact-tested target faces, traceability from mould to finished unit, CE, FCC and RoHS approvals.
- [Dartboard Certifications: CE, FCC, RoHS](https://dayinsport.com/quality/certifications/): DAYIN electronic dartboards carry CE, FCC and RoHS approvals, with traceability from mould to finished unit. Certificate documents are available on request.

## Guides
- [Resources for Dartboard Buyers](https://dayinsport.com/resources/): Buyer guides, FAQ, glossary and the 2026 DAYIN dartboard catalogue: everything a brand or importer needs to specify an electronic dartboard programme.
- [Buyer Guides for Electronic Dartboards](https://dayinsport.com/resources/guides/): Guides for brands and importers: dartboard target segments, display codes, choosing an electronic dartboard manufacturer and correct throwing posture.
- [Electronic Dartboard OEM FAQ](https://dayinsport.com/resources/faq/): Answers for dartboard buyers: lead times, samples, MOQ, customisation, certifications, factories in China and Vietnam, warranty, app and games.
- [2026 Electronic Dartboard Catalogue (PDF)](https://dayinsport.com/resources/catalogue/): Download the 2026 DAYIN dartboard catalogue: 77 models with specs, carton sizes and container loads, plus OEM options for segments, colours, doors and displays.
- [Electronic Dartboard Glossary](https://dayinsport.com/resources/glossary/): Definitions of electronic dartboard terms: segments (STD, PRO, JMB, NEO), variations, cricket readouts, OX door panels, display types, OEM, ODM and container loads.
